ticker.name: NIPPON SKI RESORT DEV CO LTD

business_summary: Nippon Ski Resort Development Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manages and operates ski resorts in Japan. It offers consulting and advisory services on ski resorts, including technical support, business support, designated management, rental business support, and other services; contract management of cableway; and rental of outdoor equipment, as well as manages parking lot. The company was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Kitaazumi, Japan. Nippon Ski Resort Development Co.,Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Nippon Parking Development Co., Ltd.
